bio: John Edward Sununu (born September 10, 1964) is an American politician who represented the state of New Hampshire in the U.S. Senate from 2003 to 2009. A member of the Republican Party, he served in the U.S. House of Representatives from 1997 to 2003. He is the son of John H. Sununu and older brother of Chris Sununu, both of whom were governors of New Hampshire.
